business_profile.business_overview: Manchester English Academy is an English language academy in Dhaka with an online course platform (LMS). Courses span Spoken English, IELTS preparation, and beginner-to-advanced levels, with visible pricing (BDT 12,000-15,000) and a student login/registration system. They publish IELTS blog content (tips, mock tests with band-9 answers). Intake is via an enquiry form.
business_profile.offer_surface: Autonomous AI agent deployment for English coaching academy — targeting: Instant admission enquiry response with course recommendation based on current level and goals; Automated level-assessment quiz to recommend the right course tier; Blog-to-enrollment conversion engaging content readers; Payment follow-up and batch reminders for enrolled students

pricing_knowledge.model: Course-based — Spoken English, IELTS, beginner to advanced (BDT 12,000-15,000)
pricing_knowledge.note: They already have an LMS and published pricing — automation-receptive. An AI agent that recommends the right course from a level assessment and converts blog readers is a natural, high-leverage fit.

business_profile.competitive_position: Manchester competes with MIE, Enhance, and many IELTS centers. Their edge is an existing LMS and published pricing. But form-based intake with no instant guidance loses students. An AI admission + level-assessment agent would convert more of their blog and course-page traffic.
business_profile.opportunity_size: With published course fees and an LMS, each enrollment is clear revenue. If form intake and no instant guidance lose a fraction of enquirers — plus blog readers who never convert — that's lost enrollment. An AI agent recovers this and fills batches.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI admission agent answering enquiries instantly and recommending courses.
2. Level-assessment quiz to place students in the right tier.
3. Blog-to-enrollment conversion agent.
4. Payment follow-up + batch reminders.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A reader of Manchester's 'IELTS mock test with band-9 answers' blog clicks to enquire at 9pm. The AI replies instantly: 'Great — want a quick 2-min level check to find your best course?' The student takes it, gets placed into IELTS Prep, and books enrollment. Manchester converted a blog reader into a paying student overnight.
